name: Logo row with a light sweep
for: A row of the brands a product works with (or real customers): the marks stay still and quiet, and every 9 s a soft band of light passes through them once.
how: fill() over the marks (one-colour inline SVG marks from scripts/icons.mjs fetch --mono, names as text), with the overlay beside the list (never inside the <ul>) and masked to a band whose position is an animated custom property: 3 s across, 6 s rest. A pause button sits at the row's right end.
rules: Real brands only, and only ones the product really works with or real customers who agreed.
Marks in one muted colour, never their brand colours here.
One sweep per page; it never runs faster than one pass in 8 s, and its pause button holds it.
a11y: A labelled list of names in text; the marks are aria-hidden and the list holds only <li>. Reduced motion shows the plain row with no band and no button.
